notes.title: Odra Online Demo Released!
notes.content:
🎮 Odra Online Demo Released! 

Step into a world of gothic fantasy and tactical warfare - the Odra Online demo is now available!

🔥 What’s inside the demo:
[list]
[*] 66 unique battle arenas with dynamic conditions — from shifting environments to hidden traps
[*] 83 combat units to command, all unlocked through the powerful Tablet system
[*] Full character roster unlocked from the start — no waiting, no grinding
[*] Quick Match system to dive into ranked PvP battles instantly
[*] Progression saved in ranked mode and transferable to the full game upon release
[/list]
⚠️ Demo limitations:
[list]
[*] Only ranked Quick Match mode is available
[*] Modes like Trials, Fighting Pits, and Training are locked in the demo
[*] Progress saves only for ranked battles
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3707200/OdraOnline_Demo/?beta=0
🎮 Ready for battle? Strategy is your greatest weapon. Download the demo now and prove your tactical mastery!
